run_edu_bert_classification: run the edu bert classifier on a huggingface dataset shard and push scored results to the hub
run_edu_bert_with_custom_model: run the edu bert script with a custom model name and dataset config via argparse flags
run_edu_bert_sharded: run the edu bert classifier on a specific shard of a dataset using shard and num_shards arguments
review_compute_scores: review the compute_scores function that tokenizes text batches and extracts logits from the classification model
refactor_main: refactor the main function to support a different cache directory or batch size for dataset processing
